roles.name: Electronics Engineer
roles.description: Designs, models, and verifies high-speed analog, digital, and mixed-signal electronic circuits and power systems.
responsibilities: Design schematic architectures and perform circuit simulations using SPICE
Validate signal integrity, power distribution networks, and thermal dissipation
Collaborate with PCB and firmware teams for hardware-software co-design
Ensure EMC/EMI compliance and adherence to ISO/FCC regulatory standards
roles.careerPath: Junior Hardware Engineer -> Electronics Engineer -> Senior Hardware Architect -> VP of Hardware Engineering

roles.name: Embedded Systems Engineer
roles.description: Develops real-time embedded hardware, Edge AI microcontrollers, and IoT sensor network architectures.
responsibilities: Architect micro-controller systems for resource-constrained edge computing
Implement communication protocols (CAN, SPI, I2C, BLE, Zigbee)
Develop low-power operating modes and battery lifecycle management algorithms
Integrate TinyML models on ARM Cortex and RISC-V architectures
roles.careerPath: Embedded Developer -> Embedded Systems Engineer -> Staff Systems Architect -> Director of Embedded Systems

roles.name: PCB Designer
roles.description: Engineers multi-layer high-density interconnect (HDI) PCB layouts, impedance matching, and thermal dissipation systems.
responsibilities: Route high-speed differential pairs, RF traces, and matched-length buses
Design stackups with controlled impedance and minimal crosstalk
Generate fabrication & assembly packages (Gerber, ODB++, BOM, Pick-and-Place)
Perform Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Testability (DFT) checks
roles.careerPath: CAD Drafter -> PCB Layout Engineer -> Senior PCB Designer -> Lead Hardware Packaging Engineer

roles.name: Firmware Engineer
roles.description: Writes low-level deterministic firmware, device drivers, bootloaders, and hardware abstraction layers.
responsibilities: Author bare-metal and RTOS firmware for microcontrollers and SoCs
Develop secure bootloaders and Over-The-Air (OTA) firmware upgrade pipelines
Implement register-level peripheral drivers (DMA, Timers, ADC/DAC, Ethernet)
Profile CPU cycles, memory footprints, and interrupt latency
roles.careerPath: Junior Firmware Dev -> Firmware Engineer -> Senior Firmware Lead -> Chief Firmware Architect

roles.name: IoT Architect
roles.description: Designs end-to-end connected device ecosystems, wireless protocols, telemetry pipelines, and cloud edge sync.
responsibilities: Architect scalable IoT device fleet onboarding, provisioning, and key lifecycle
Select wireless communication topologies (NB-IoT, LoRaWAN, Cellular, Wi-Fi 6, Thread)
Establish edge-to-cloud security, encryption (TLS/DTLS), and digital twins
Optimize bandwidth utilization and MQTT/CoAP message serialization
roles.careerPath: IoT Engineer -> Senior IoT Systems Engineer -> IoT Solutions Architect -> VP of Connected Products

roles.name: Test Engineer
roles.description: Automates automated testing equipment (ATE), environmental stress testing, and quality characterization for electronics.
responsibilities: Design automated test racks with programmable power supplies, loads, and DMMs
Author automated validation scripts for functional, temperature, and shock testing
Analyze failure modes, root causes, and yield statistics using 6-Sigma tools
Build Hardware-In-the-Loop (HIL) simulators for firmware validation
roles.careerPath: Test Technician -> Test Engineer -> Senior Hardware QA Lead -> Director of Quality Engineering

roles.name: Manufacturing Engineer
roles.description: Optimizes high-volume surface mount technology (SMT) lines, automated optical inspection (AOI), and yield rates.
responsibilities: Set up solder paste printers, pick-and-place machines, and reflow ovens
Configure AOI and AXI (Automated X-Ray Inspection) defect classification rules
Collaborate with suppliers to streamline component sourcing and pallet designs
Implement lean manufacturing and continuous cycle-time reductions
roles.careerPath: Manufacturing Tech -> Manufacturing Engineer -> Plant Ops Manager -> Director of Global Manufacturing

roles.name: VLSI Physical Design Engineer
roles.description: Transforms RTL/gate-level netlists into complete silicon layout, optimizing power, performance, and area (PPA).
responsibilities: Execute floorplanning, power grid synthesis, and clock tree synthesis (CTS)
Run placement and routing (P&R) across sub-5nm semiconductor process nodes
Achieve timing closure via Static Timing Analysis (STA) across all PVT corners
Verify physical DRC, LVS, antenna rules, and electromigration constraints
roles.careerPath: Physical Design Engineer -> Senior P&R Lead -> Principal Chip Architect -> Director of Silicon Engineering

roles.name: ASIC Verification Engineer
roles.description: Develops robust Universal Verification Methodology (UVM) testbenches and ensures 100% functional and code coverage.
responsibilities: Build constrained-random verification environments using SystemVerilog and UVM
Write functional assertions (SVA) and covergroups to validate architectural specs
Perform formal property verification and gate-level simulation debug
Analyze corner-case silicon bugs before tape-out
roles.careerPath: Verification Engineer -> Senior UVM Architect -> Verification Manager -> VP of Silicon Quality

roles.name: FPGA Design Engineer
roles.description: Implements ultra-low-latency digital signal processing and acceleration algorithms on modern FPGA fabrics.
responsibilities: Author RTL in VHDL and SystemVerilog for high-throughput streaming pipelines
Integrate PCIe, 100GbE, and high-speed memory controllers (DDR4/DDR5/HBM)
Close timing at high clock frequencies with aggressive pipeline stages
Deploy hardware acceleration for fintech, telecom 5G, or neural network inference
roles.careerPath: FPGA Developer -> Senior FPGA Architect -> Lead Acceleration Engineer -> VP of Hardware Systems

roles.name: RF & Microwave Engineer
roles.description: Designs high-frequency transceivers, antenna arrays, power amplifiers, and wireless front-ends.
responsibilities: Model transmission lines, microstrip circuits, and Smith chart matching networks
Design RF power amplifiers (PA), low noise amplifiers (LNA), and beamforming antennas
Perform EM simulations for 5G/6G, radar, satellite, and Wi-Fi 7 modules
Measure S-parameters, noise figures, and EVM using Vector Network Analyzers (VNA)
roles.careerPath: RF Engineer -> Senior Microwave Specialist -> Principal RF Architect -> Chief RF Scientist

roles.name: Robotics & Mechatronics Engineer
roles.description: Integrates electro-mechanical actuators, motor drivers, sensor fusion, and closed-loop motion control.
responsibilities: Design BLDC/PMSM motor drive electronics, H-bridges, and current sensing loops
Implement PID, FOC (Field Oriented Control), and trajectory planning algorithms
Integrate IMUs, encoders, LiDAR, and computer vision sensors
Validate mechanical-electrical tolerances and dynamic responsiveness
roles.careerPath: Mechatronics Engineer -> Robotics Systems Lead -> Autonomous Systems Director

roles.name: Hardware Security Engineer
roles.description: Protects electronic circuits against side-channel attacks, fault injection, hardware trojans, and reverse engineering.
responsibilities: Perform power analysis (DPA/CPA) and fault injection (laser/voltage glitching) audits
Implement Hardware Root of Trust (RoT), PUFs (Physically Unclonable Functions), and TPM
Secure JTAG/debug ports against physical extraction and memory tampering
Architect cryptographic hardware accelerators (AES, ECC, Post-Quantum Crypto)
roles.careerPath: Security Analyst -> Hardware Security Engineer -> Principal Trust Architect -> Head of Product Security

roles.name: Power Electronics Engineer
roles.description: Designs high-efficiency switched-mode power supplies (SMPS), inverters, and battery management systems (BMS).
responsibilities: Architect DC-DC buck, boost, flyback, and resonant LLC converters
Utilize Wide Bandgap (WBG) semiconductors: GaN (Gallium Nitride) and SiC (Silicon Carbide)
Design high-voltage isolation, gate drivers, and magnetic component transformers
Optimize power density, thermal dissipation, and conversion efficiencies above 98%
roles.careerPath: Power Engineer -> Senior Power Architect -> Principal Energy Systems Engineer

roles.name: Signal Processing Engineer
roles.description: Develops real-time digital filtering, spectral estimation, audio/radar beamforming, and image enhancement pipelines.
responsibilities: Model FIR, IIR, adaptive LMS, and Kalman filters for noisy sensory data
Convert floating-point mathematical algorithms to fixed-point embedded implementations
Design FFT/wavelet spectral analysis pipelines for audio, radar, or biomedical signals
Optimize SIMD/NEON vector instructions for DSP and ARM cores
roles.careerPath: DSP Engineer -> Senior Signal Architect -> Principal Algorithmic Scientist

roles.name: Analog & Mixed-Signal IC Designer
roles.description: Designs custom silicon transistor-level operational amplifiers, bandgaps, PLLs, ADCs, and DACs.
responsibilities: Design transistor schematics for low-noise amplifiers, op-amps, and high-speed data converters
Simulate Monte Carlo process variations, noise analysis, and corner models
Guide custom silicon layout for common-centroid matching, shielding, and guard rings
Perform silicon post-silicon characterization in cleanroom lab benches
certifications: IEEE Solid-State Circuits Society Fellow Track
roles.careerPath: Analog IC Engineer -> Senior Mixed-Signal Lead -> Principal Silicon Architect

roles.name: Semiconductor Test & Product Engineer
roles.description: Brings new silicon chips from foundry tape-out to high-volume qualified production through automated wafer sorting.
responsibilities: Program Automated Test Equipment (ATE) for wafer sort and final package testing
Design probe cards, load boards, and socket fixtures for silicon characterization
Perform yield analysis, shmoo plotting, and burn-in reliability qualification
Collaborate with foundries (TSMC, GlobalFoundries) on wafer defects and dicing
roles.careerPath: Product Engineer -> Senior ATE Lead -> Director of Semiconductor Operations

roles.name: Microcontroller Application Engineer
roles.description: Develops reference designs, application notes, evaluation kits, and customer firmware implementations.
responsibilities: Design proof-of-concept hardware evaluation boards demonstrating silicon features
Author software development kits (SDKs), middleware libraries, and peripheral drivers
Troubleshoot field technical issues for OEM client engineering teams
Publish comprehensive technical application notes and benchmark reports
roles.careerPath: Field Application Engineer -> Microcontroller Specialist -> Director of Customer Solutions

roles.name: Sensor Integration Specialist
roles.description: Selects, calibrates, and integrates environmental, optical, inertial, and biomedical sensors into compact devices.
responsibilities: Evaluate MEMS accelerometers, gyroscopes, magnetometers, gas sensors, and photodiode arrays
Implement multi-point temperature calibration and drift compensation algorithms
Design low-noise analog signal conditioning circuitry (instrumentation amplifiers, active filters)
Characterize latency, quantization noise, and dynamic range
roles.careerPath: Sensor Engineer -> Senior Integration Specialist -> Principal Sensor Systems Lead

roles.name: Optical & Optoelectronics Engineer
roles.description: Designs laser diodes, photodetectors, fiber optic transceivers, and photonic integrated circuits.
responsibilities: Design optical waveguides, collimating lenses, and laser driver circuits
Simulate beam propagation, diffraction, and coupling losses using photonics CAD
Integrate high-speed optical transceivers for data centers and LiDAR systems
Perform eye diagram and bit error rate (BER) measurements up to 100Gbps
roles.careerPath: Optics Engineer -> Senior Photonics Architect -> Chief Optical Scientist

roles.name: Mechatronics Control Specialist
roles.description: Optimizes high-precision servo positioning, PID loops, and real-time state feedback for automated machines.
responsibilities: Model transfer functions, Bode plots, and root locus stability criteria for electromechanical axes
Tune cascade PID, feedforward, and active vibration damping controllers
Integrate absolute optical encoders and linear scales with sub-micron resolution
Implement safety-rated stop protocols and emergency interlocks
roles.careerPath: Controls Engineer -> Senior Mechatronics Specialist -> Director of Industrial Automation
